thread: marisol: did a quick audit of the Metrics table and dropdown filters with VoiceOver + keyboard. couple of surprising things: marisol: • column headers are clickable to sort but they're not announced as buttons; VO says "column header" only and doesn't expose sort state marisol: • the per-row action menu (kebab) is visually focusable but the flyout uses `role=\"menu\"` with no aria-labelledby, so VO reads 'menu' but no context which row it's for marisol: • the severity color dot in the left-most column has no accessible name. screen reader just skips it which loses info for low-vision users marisol: filing here before I make small PRs devin: thanks. for sortable headers we usually apply `role=\"button\" aria-pressed` (or `aria-sort`) and keyboard handlers for Enter/Space. prefer `aria-sort=\"ascending|descending|none\"` on the th element anya: agree — aria-sort on the th is the canonical pattern and works with NVDA/JAWS. also add visually hidden text like "sorted ascending" that updates on change so tests can assert marisol: for the kebab -> menu association I patched the flyout to include `aria-labelledby=\"row-123-action-label\"` and added an id on the row label with the row name. quick test with VO now reads "Actions for Model X, menu, collapsed" which is much better devin: nice. for the severity dot do `role=\"img\" aria-label=\"Severity: high\"` or wrap with `High severity` depending on how we want it announced. ensure we don't duplicate text for screen readers accessibility-bot: periodic scan (metrics-table/2026-03-24) 4 issues flagged (2 medium: aria-sort missing; 1 high: menu not labelled). See https://ci.redwood/axe/scan/3562 marisol: i'm going to create three tiny PRs: 1) th -> aria-sort + keyboard; 2) flyout menu labelled per-row; 3) severity dot accessible name. each includes a small e2e VoiceOver run and unit checks. anya: please include acceptance steps in the PR: tab into headers, press Enter to sort, SR announces new order; open kebab, VO says "Actions for "; severity announced when row focused. tag @eng-accessibility and @qa for the e2e. devin: estimate 0.5 days each PR. will add storybook examples to show SR text in the knobs. will also update CHANGELOG accessibility notes. marisol: thanks — i'll open PRs as drafts. will run axe after changes and post the scan link. closing once PRs merged.
